fixes.explanation: Three men from each tribe, and you nailed it (Joshua 18:4). Seven tribes, three men each, and not one of them could say "I thought you had the map." The text says they went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions, then came back with the document (Joshua 18:9). That's a whole land on paper, friend. I can barely finish one cookie box without checking the recipe twice.
